scope.panel: Frozen development panel, 80 OPV2V frames, 16 scenes. Not a generalization evaluation.
scope.transport: Fixed shared 100 Mbps uplink, 256 KiB application cap and 5 ms one-way propagation (RTT 10 ms). Modeled arrival uses actual serialized header, index and feature bytes.
scope.complete: Full original or exact compact feature state, fusion, detect, then postprocess. Ready times derive from actual CUDA-synchronized trial clocks and a fixed modeled arrival, not concurrent or physical end-to-end measurement.
scope.ap: Full-task AP has empty predictions for late complete outputs with all GT retained. Delivered AP uses the frozen local fallback when full output is late. None of the three arms triggers a partial cooperative output.
scope.time_accounting: Absolute modeled-replay milestones and independent stopwatch durations are separate. Occupancy and exposed queue times are interval unions, not sums across overlapping CPU/CUDA lanes. A original decode and input transfer share an ingress envelope; B/C raw phase durations are summed service demand, not elapsed path time.

statistics.thresholds: Observed k-th order statistic per arm, with paired scene resampling. Extrema intervals are descriptive for this frozen panel.

decision.criterion: Predeclared C-minus-A coverage contrast with positive lower paired 95% CI at 45 or 50 ms; B-minus-A and C-minus-B identify the mechanisms. Bonferroni sensitivity is recorded separately.
decision.analysis_scope: Development feasibility frontier. Require independent confirmation before a generalization claim.
